tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind the file area on web and the app's screen background on mobile.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: File tiles, list rows and inputs: the brightest ground in light, the deepest in dark.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Nav rail, top search bar and details panel: the app chrome around the content area.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Menus, the upload tray body and the bottom nav.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets; hover fill on list rows.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Pressed fill, the storage meter track and thumbnail placeholders.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: File names, titles and body text on every surface and surface-container token, both themes.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Metadata (size, modified, owner), secondary labels and inactive icons, on every surface token.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Input and outlined-button borders, the unchecked checkbox; 3:1 on every surface token.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Dividers and tile borders. Decorative only: never the only cue for a state.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one accent: filled button, focus ring, links, progress, the selected check. As text, on any surface token.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Selected file tiles and rows, the drop-zone highlight, the active upload row.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Active nav item indicator, selected filter chips, tonal buttons.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-container.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Failed uploads, destructive actions (Delete forever), quota over 95%. As text, on any surface token.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on an error fill (the Delete forever button).

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and the failed upload row.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text on error-container.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Upload complete, backup OK. Always with a check icon or a word. As text, on any surface token.

tokens.name: success-container
tokens.usage: Background behind success text in banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Quota over 80%, duplicate found, link expiring. Always with an icon or a word. As text, on any surface token.

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: Background behind warning text (the duplicate banner).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring 2px outside the control. Alias of primary, 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: file-folder
tokens.usage: Folder icon. Folders stay neutral, as in Drive, so coloured file types stand out.

tokens.name: file-pdf
tokens.usage: PDF icon and badge glyph.

tokens.name: file-doc
tokens.usage: Word, ODT, RTF icon.

tokens.name: file-sheet
tokens.usage: Excel, ODS, CSV icon.

tokens.name: file-slides
tokens.usage: PowerPoint, ODP icon.

tokens.name: file-image
tokens.usage: Image icon (shown only until the thumbnail loads).

tokens.name: file-video
tokens.usage: Video icon and the duration badge's accent.

tokens.name: file-audio
tokens.usage: Audio icon.

tokens.name: file-archive
tokens.usage: Zip and other archives.

tokens.name: file-text
tokens.usage: Plain text, Markdown, code, JSON; also the fallback for unknown types.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: headline-md
styles.usage: Page title on desktop (My files, Trash, Search results). One per screen.

styles.name: headline-sm
styles.usage: Page title on phones; empty-state heading.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Dialog and bottom-sheet titles; the viewer's file name.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Section headings in the details panel and settings.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Group headings inside the file area (Folders / Files).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Inga filer här ännu. Släpp filer för att ladda upp.
styles.usage: Default body size on phones (web and React Native); dialog body text.

styles.name: body-md
styles.usage: Default on desktop: file names in tiles and rows, menu items, inputs.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata under file names, helper text, timestamps.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Uppercase overlines (CURRENT on a version), video duration badge.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Checksums, API keys, job ids in admin views. Never for file names.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Use the steps; 2px is allowed only for hairline offsets such as the focus ring gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in chips and dense rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; padding inside chips; tile caption gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of tiles and list cells; gap between grid tiles on mobile.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard padding: cards, dialogs on mobile, the page gutter on phones; gap between grid tiles on desktop.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside the details panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding on desktop; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a page heading; between dialog sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, type badges, duration badges on video thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, menus, list-row hover fill, thumbnails inside tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: File tiles and cards; the upload tray.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs; the top corners of mobile bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The search bar and the nav indicator pill.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, avatars, progress bars and the storage meter.

shadow.note: Elevation is mostly tonal (surface-container steps). Shadows only on things that float above the file area.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Hovered file tile, the floating action bar.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Menus and the upload tray.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

size.note: Fixed dimensions shared by web and React Native (px = dp).

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside dense list rows, chips and buttons.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Default icon size: nav, toolbars, file-type icons in lists.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on mobile web and React Native; also the list row height.

tokens.name: size-row-dense
tokens.usage: List row height on desktop with a pointer (the compact density).

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Button, icon button and input height.

tokens.name: size-tile-min
tokens.usage: Minimum file tile width in the grid; columns are auto-fill.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Width of the collapsed desktop nav rail.

tokens.name: size-nav-drawer
tokens.usage: Width of the expanded desktop nav (labels beside icons).

tokens.name: size-topbar
tokens.usage: Height of the top bar with search.

tokens.name: size-details
tokens.usage: Width of the details panel (info, sharing, versions, activity).

duration.note: Easing: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) for things entering, cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 1, 1) for things leaving.

tokens.name: duration-short
tokens.usage: Hover and press fills, checkbox ticks.

tokens.name: duration-medium
tokens.usage: Menus, chips, the selection bar sliding in.

tokens.name: duration-long
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, the details panel. With prefers-reduced-motion these become instant cross-fades.
